entries.title: Psalms 19:1
segments: <<For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.>> The heavens declare the glory of God; And the firmament showeth his handiwork.

entries.title: Psalms 19:2
segments: Day unto day uttereth speech, And night unto night showeth knowledge.

entries.title: Psalms 19:3
segments: There is no speech nor language; Their voice is not heard.

entries.title: Psalms 19:4
segments: Their line is gone out through all the earth, And their words to the end of the world. In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun,

entries.title: Psalms 19:5
segments: Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, And rejoiceth as a strong man to run his course.

entries.title: Psalms 19:6
segments: His going forth is from the end of the heavens, And his circuit unto the ends of it; And there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.

entries.title: Psalms 19:7
segments: The law of Jehovah is perfect, restoring the soul: The testimony of Jehovah is sure, making wise the simple.

entries.title: Psalms 19:8
segments: The precepts of Jehovah are right, rejoicing the heart: The commandment of Jehovah is pure, enlightening the eyes.

entries.title: Psalms 19:9
segments: The fear of Jehovah is clean, enduring for ever: The ordinances of Jehovah are true, [and] righteous altogether.

entries.title: Psalms 19:10
segments: More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold; Sweeter also than honey and the droppings of the honeycomb.

entries.title: Psalms 19:11
segments: Moreover by them is thy servant warned: In keeping them there is great reward.

entries.title: Psalms 19:12
segments: Who can discern [his] errors? Clear thou me from hidden [faults].

entries.title: Psalms 19:13
segments: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous [sins]; Let them not have dominion over me: Then shall I be upright, And I shall be clear from great transgression.

entries.title: Psalms 19:14
segments: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart Be acceptable in thy sight, O Jehovah, my rock, and my redeemer.
